title: Enterprise dedicated intake: SLA matrix & hybrid scaling model prioritization
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: We continue to receive enterprise requests that mix strict latency SLAs, reserved throughput commitments, and burst behavior. Current intake artifacts focus on static throughput profiles and static GPU tiers. This ticket defines a pragmatic SLA matrix and a hybrid scaling model to prioritize intake, map customers to GPU classes, and automate fallback/burst policies. Goals: 1) Create a two-dimensional SLA matrix (latency SLO x reserved throughput) with recommended minimal GPU class and buffer % for burst. 2) Define a hybrid scaling policy where reserved pools satisfy base throughput and controlled bursts spill to shared hosted capacity with explicit preemption/notification rules. 3) Produce an intake rubric and onboarding questionnaire to consistently score requests and assign priority tiers. 4) Capture pricing/contract language implications and required console UI fields for Dedicated onboarding. Proposed SLA matrix: - Latency tiers: Low (<50ms p50 token), Medium (50-200ms), High (>200ms but bounded). - Throughput bands: Micro (<=50 rps), Small (51-500 rps), Large (501-5000 rps), XLarge (>5000 rps). - Map each cell to a recommended GPU family (e.g., A100-40GB, H100-80GB, or multi-GPU sharding) and KV cache sizing guidance. Hybrid scaling model: - Base: reserved capacity guaranteed for committed throughput. - Burst: short-duration overflow routed to hosted pools or burst reserve with soft-SLA and quota. - Preemption & throttling: clear rules for graceful degradation, RPC-level error codes, and customer notifications. - Autoscale triggers: queue depth, token/sec, and tail-latency anomalies. Intake rubric & score: - Business criticality (0-5), Data sensitivity (0-5), Predictability of workload (0-5), Acceptable degradation model (0-5), Contract value (0-5). Score -> Priority band (P0/P1/P2) and recommended onboarding path (Concierge, Standard, Self-serve). Acceptance criteria: - Finalized SLA matrix published to Confluence and referenced in onboarding checklist. - Intake form prototype added to Console mockups. - Pricing guidance drafted for Legal/RevOps review. - Pilot with 2 existing enterprise customers and run a smoke test of hybrid bursting. Artifacts & links: Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DED/pages/Hybrid+SLA+Matrix (draft) | Intake form spreadsheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleIntakeForm | Console mockup PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/8123 | Slack thread: #dedicated-intake (thread ts: 1676320000.000200). Next steps: 1) Review GPU-family mapping with Runtime team (owner: Miguel). 2) Sync with Legal on sample contract language (owner: Aisha). 3) Design mockups for Console fields and onboarding flow (owner: Design). 4) Run pilot onboarding checklist with existing customer ACME.ai (owner: Solutions Eng).
